introduction:
Sample Desk helps users keep a short list of work items.

This sample content is used only to validate the manual builder.

features.title: Adding a Work Item
features.purpose: Create a work item so it appears in your list.
features.location: Open the Work Items page and click New Item.
steps: Click Save. The new item appears in the list.
tips: Names must be entered before you can save the item.
